node.title: Rate-half distance-three e=1 Hankel-design route fence
node.statement: Over F_17 there is an explicit e=1,r=3 rate-half analogue whose full lifted syndrome pencil is column-far and has exactly five finite supported slopes, while its contracted pencil satisfies the distance-three pair normal form, exact external split design, exceptional rank/transversality gate, and adj M=c_H z q q^T. Its quotient support has four triples, so it lies below the official r>=4 uniqueness threshold and is route evidence, not a prize counterexample.
